verdict.rationale: Oneleet documents one native bulk action: 'Publish draft policies' publishes every draft that doesn't need review from the Policies page in a single step. That is real multi-item handling, but only for policy publishing. Nothing shows bulk actions on findings, controls or devices, and nothing shows batch endpoints in the API or MCP server that an AI-native user would drive. missing for 10: bulk operations across other item types (findings triage/assign, controls, devices), documented batch API or MCP operations, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: On the **Policies** page, choose **Publish draft policies** to publish drafts that don’t require review.
